title: Remote Entry Configuration
description: Safe configuration for keryx serve. Holds a credential reference only; a raw bearer token is forbidden in this document.

enabled.description: Off by default. A fresh install must serialize this as false.

address.description: Bind address. Any value outside the loopback range additionally requires acknowledgeNonLoopback and an explicit CLI flag.

acknowledgeNonLoopback.description: Explicit acknowledgement that the listener is reachable beyond loopback. Without it a non-loopback address is a startup refusal.

profile.description: Name of the remote policy profile, resolved through the existing policy source. It may never be weaker than the local profile.

credentialRef.description: Opaque reference to the bearer token. The token value never appears here.

expirySeconds.description: Unanswered approvals resolve to deny at expiry.

retentionDays.description: Retention period for redacted turn evidence and approval records.
